behavioral_sequences.name: command_turnaround_response
behavioral_sequences.trigger: Master asserts ESPI_CS# to begin a transaction (spec §4)

steps.action: Master drives 8-bit CMD opcode on ESPI_IO
Master drives command-specific fields and optional payload
Master drives CRC byte if CRC enabled
Bus turnaround (TAR) — ownership passes to slave
Slave drives response data + 16-bit STATUS + CRC
Slave drives ESPI_ALERT# to signal service-required
Master reads which channel's AVAIL bit is set in 16-bit STATUS
Master issues the matching GET_* command for that channel

behavioral_sequences.name: virtual_wire_tunnel
behavioral_sequences.trigger: PUT_VWIRE (0x10) / GET_VWIRE (0x11) opcode on the Virtual Wire channel (spec §5/§9)

steps.action: Sender forms a VW packet: count byte + (index, data) pairs
Each index addresses up to 4 virtual wires; data carries 4 valid bits + 4 wire-value bits
Receiver updates the tunneled sideband signals

derived_no_calibration_source.literal: no calibration / trim / OTP-cal source in input
derived_no_calibration_source.label: L12 no_calibration auto-set (#634 facet e) — absence-based, mirrors L5.no_analog

command_sequence: Master drives 8-bit CMD opcode on ESPI_IO.
Master drives command-specific fields and optional payload.
Bus turnaround (TAR) 2 clocks — ownership passes to slave.
Slave drives response data + 16-bit STATUS + CRC.
alert_sequence: Master reads which channel's AVAIL bit is set.
Master issues the matching GET_* command.
vwire_sequence: Master/slave forms VW packet: count byte + (index, data) pairs.
Each index addresses up to 4 virtual wires; data carries 4 valid bits + 4 wire-value bits.
Receiver updates the tunneled sideband signals.
